Puerta Bonita — Madrid, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

A January 2025 report described ongoing problems around a disused, informally occupied football field: illegal late-night parties, unlicensed alcohol sales, noise, rubbish accumulation and an improvised camp, described by a government delegate as 'degradation, filth and abandonment.' A resident-opinion page describes an improved overall trajectory, with past criminal-incident concerns having eased. Sources checked: El Espanol, 22 Jan 2025; barriosmadrid.net resident-opinion page.

Wandroz currently rates Puerta Bonita in Madrid, Spain as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night.
